services.name: Fall Apple Picking
services.desc: Due to the nature of our crop, we cannot guarantee that apples will be available for picking on your select date. For over 50 years, visiting the farm has been an annual tradition. Our farm is a place for families to not only select their own apples, but to enjoy a taste of country life. Apples come in many varieties and each is uniquely different in its own way. We grow over 18 varieties of apples that are available to be picked by our guests. We have over 47,500 trees across 60 acres in our orchard. services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Treat your employees to a fun filled day on the farm by purchasing tickets in advance and enjoy the freedom of being on the farm! What a great way to thank your employees, their families and your clients too! Experience scenic tractor wagon rides by the Niagara Escarpment, visit our farm animal area and nature trail that features swing ropes. Watch your children enjoy the play area that features four huge slides and tower… and there is even a hay maze! Experience apple picking in the Fall with lots of different varieties. services.name: School Groups
services.desc: For many years, a field trip to Chudleigh’s has been a popular choice for school kids from all around! The farm offers the perfect balance of fun and learning and is sure to help make lasting memories. Book your time slot online and enjoy limitless access to the farm. Although we are unable to book a large group with a designated area, you can still have a great day of fun and learning at Chudleigh’s. If you have more questions about visiting the farm with your school group, please visit our Frequently Asked Questions. Enjoy access to the farm and all our activities on your chosen day! blurb: Guests purchase timed admission tickets online to visit the farm, which includes access to the orchard, children's entertainment area, and market. Activities include scenic tractor wagon rides, apple picking, farm animal area, nature trail, play area with slides and hay maze, and seasonal events like Summer Music Nights. The farm operates rain or shine and does not allow outside food or drinks on the premises.
